lines.3: 「Shall we commence today's go-home club activities?」
lines.4: 「All right, guess I'll head over to track practice.」
lines.6: 「...You guys work hard at your club, too.」
lines.7: 「You bet. I'm gonna give it everything I've got and go straight home.」
lines.8: 「The go-home club has hardships of its own, you know. Not that you track guys could understand.」
lines.9: 「Hah. Can't say I want to. But fine, I'll hear you out. What hardships?」
lines.10: 「Oh, there are plenty. While the track team, karate club, and everyone else are working their butts off, we saunter home without a care. Then we get there, and suddenly a thought crosses our minds.」
lines.11: 「Am I really okay like this? Am I just frittering away my youth? No, I simply haven't gotten serious yet. I've always been told I could do it if I really tried.」
lines.12: 「Hmm, but when I seriously consider my future, it's honestly terrifying. Better play a game and take my mind off it!」
lines.13: 「...So we pretend not to notice what we've become. Then, on very rare occasions, the self-loathing kicks in. It's less hardship than anguish.」
lines.14: 「...Yeah, sounds rough. Have fun agonizing over it. See ya.」
lines.16: 「No, it was beautiful. You were like the living symbol of a hopeless bum.」
lines.20: 「Damn that Subaru. The guys are scared of him, but he's still popular with the girls. Just because he plays the outlaw.」
lines.21: 「Oh, and just so we're clear, I'm not jealous or anything, okay? Seriously.」
lines.25: 「Well, Subaru is handsome. Best-looking guy in class.」
lines.26: 「So looks really are everything. But I'm not bad myself, right? I'm a rugged man of glasses.」
lines.27: 「Putting it politely, Fukahire, I'd say you fall into the ugly category.」
lines.29: 「If you want me to say it, I won't hold back.」
lines.31: 「Well, you're not that bad if you keep quiet. The moment you open your mouth, though, you radiate loser energy.」
lines.32: 「Hey, don't get too full of yourself, Crab.」
lines.33: 「Whatever. I've got my 2D girls. They're pretty great, you know.」
lines.34: Not even those sparkling eyes could sell me on that.
lines.39: 「Yoppi's such a sweet girl, isn't she? Reality really does have a certain warmth. All right, I'll keep at it tomorrow!」
lines.40: He was so easy to read.
lines.42: 「Why are you looking around like that?」
lines.43: 「What, can you finally see fairies now? Want me to take you to a hospital?」
lines.44: 「No... Don't you feel someone staring at us?」
lines.46: 「I have the distinct feeling somebody is watching me.」
lines.47: 「Nobody would waste their time looking at you, Fukahire.」
lines.48: 「No, I can definitely feel this piercing gaze...」
lines.49: 「What's that called again? A fisheries research station?」
